closing.summary: Big strengths are carb quality, omega 3, and protein, but the biggest weaknesses are low magnesium, low vitamin A, and fairly salty. It is good for practical meals, muscles, and low-calorie volume because the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around, protein still gives it a muscle-support angle, and it can add bulk or fullness without much calorie pressure.
